summary: Tested the POS P0 features end to end: backend pytest (16/16 passed) plus Playwright UI runs on desktop 1920 and mobile 390. Owner 2-step login (baa/130994) and the POS cashier PIN gate work. The Dine In/Takeaway/Online selector, the pos-table-select gate, split validation (cash > 0 and < total, QRIS computed automatically), the stock-unverified lock (product-grid visible, all products, bundles and checkout disabled) and the 6-digit rider attendance PIN (numeric-only, maxlength 6, button disabled without photo + 6 digits, wrong PIN rejected 401 with a toast) all work. Backend checks passed: POST /sales validations, split persistence, EOD, /reports/sales all/cash/qris, dashboard/summary and rider-rank (the split amount is neither doubled nor lost), client_id idempotency, and the EOD close lock. Found 2 split-related display/accounting bugs (fractional cup qty in EOD; history table counts split cups as QRIS), a floating AI-button overlap and a duplicate test ID. All QA data has been cleaned up.

minor.issue: For split sales, rows[].cash_qty / qris_qty are split by the payment ratio, so they become non-integer floats (e.g. 2 cups at 10000 cash / 14000 QRIS -> cash_qty 0.8333333333333334, qris_qty 1.1666666666666667). The amount totals are correct (cash 18000, QRIS 14000, total 32000). Cup counts should not be fractional: add a split_qty column or round/allocate whole cups.

The response overwrites sale['order_type'] with 'bundling'/'regular'. The order_type query param also means bundling/regular, which clashes with the new dine_in/takeaway/online order_type field. There is no report breakdown by Dine In/Takeaway/Online. Suggest renaming the internal field to sale_kind and adding a distribution by service type.
Error messages are in English ('Wrong rider PIN', 'Attendance already recorded today') in an Indonesian UI. Check-in also does not reject inactive riders (it does not check active=false).
PinGate calls verify-pin at 4 and 5 digits before the 6th digit, so every unlock produces 2 x 401 console errors. verify-pin has no brute-force lockout.

ui_bugs.issue: The per-menu Cash/QRIS table uses h.payment_method === 'cash' ? c : q, so split sales are counted entirely as QRIS (2-cup split sale showed Cash 0 / QRIS 2). This is inconsistent with EOD. It needs to handle payment_method 'split' (e.g. a separate Split column, or use payment_parts).
Fractional cash_qty/qris_qty from the backend are shown raw ('0.8333333333333334') and overflow the 6-column grid, overlapping the neighbouring column.
The attendance checkout button uses data-testid='checkout-button', the same as the POS cart checkout-button. Rename it to attendance-checkout-button.

When stock is saved but not yet verified by the rider (pending_stock=true), the message still says 'Belum ada stok awal hari ini. Minta Bar Team / Superadmin menyimpan Stok Rider dulu.', which is misleading. Show a 'menunggu verifikasi Rider' message instead.

issues: The floating 'Tanya AI' CoachChat button overlaps the 'Bayar' checkout button on desktop and covers the split-qris-amount field on mobile. Add bottom padding to the cart or move the FAB.
The pay-split button is icon-only (Split icon) with no text or aria-label, unlike the CASH/QRIS labels. Add a 'SPLIT' label.
The split-payment-hint text-amber-600 has low contrast on the dark card.
Radix warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' (pre-existing, accessibility).

action_items: Fix the POS history histRows so split sales are not counted as QRIS (use payment_parts or a split column)
Make EOD cup quantities for split sales whole numbers (split_qty column or integer allocation) and format them in the EOD receipt
Move or offset the Tanya AI FAB so it does not overlap checkout-button / split panel
Rename the attendance checkout testid to avoid clashing with the cart checkout-button
Show a distinct pending-verification message when pos/stock pending_stock=true
Optional: show the Dine In/Takeaway/Online breakdown in /reports/sales; localize attendance error messages; add a label to the split button
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2049 lines; split it into routers (sales, attendance, reports, auth).
Frontend sends payment_method 'cash' for split payments. The backend derives 'split' from payment_parts, which works but is confusing; send 'split' explicitly.
reports/sales mutates sale['order_type'] with bundling/regular, so the semantics collide with the new order_type field.
Bundles in eod_summary still use 'method': s['payment_method'] (split) while cash/QRIS amounts are prorated. This is fine, but downstream consumers must handle 'split'.
The rider-stock POST decrements menus.stock even before rider verification (pre-existing behaviour).

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (core flows pass; 2 split display bugs + overlap)
